scope: All 31 substantial-and-evidence-backed pages were checked for a calculation their own inspected evidence could reproduce.

retainedFromEarlierBatch.calculation: Newton iteration converging to the square root of two
retainedFromEarlierBatch.note: Retained as the positive fixture. Not re-counted as a Batch 12 conversion.

refused.candidate: NeuroBench synaptic-operation counts on the spiking-neural-networks page
refused.reason: The framework defines Dense, Eff_MACs and Eff_ACs precisely, but defines them over a specific model's weights and activations. No model is named on the page, so there are no inputs to compute over. Inventing a model to have something to count would be fabricating the input.
The page's whole point is that metabolic estimates and wall-plug joules are not commensurable without a declared boundary. Producing a number here would enact the error the page warns against.

refused.candidate: Connection-sparsity ratio on the neuromorphic-computing page
refused.reason: Sparsity is defined as zero weights over total weights. The page names no weight matrix, so the ratio has no operands.

refused.candidate: Douay-Rheims and King James divergence counts
refused.reason: Counting differing words between two editions is arithmetic over a text, not a calculation with a governing equation or an uncertainty. Presenting it as one would dress a word count as a derivation.

boundary: No calculation was added. Four candidates were examined and each failed on inputs or uncertainty, which are the two requirements that cannot be supplied by wanting a calculation to exist.
